source_document.body:
We’ve got an exciting collection of Green Deals for you today, headlined by the launch of EcoFlow’s new TITAN Series Whole-Home Backup Ecosystem with up to $2,199 savings starting from $2,374 . Right behind that is the three new Lectric Limited-Edition XP4 750 Folding Utility e-bike deals with up to $840 in FREE bundled gear at $1,399 , while the Monarc sub-brand is offering the very first price cuts for Black Friday savings on its Tracer Commuter and Marker All-Terrain e-bikes at new lows starting from $1,299 . We also spotted Govee’s Matter Outdoor Lamp Post at a new $140 low , as well as some Worx deals for a 2,200 PSI pressure washer and an Aerocart firewood carrier attachment. You’ll find yesterday’s deals down at the bottom of the page, including the rare savings from MOD’s Black Friday e-bike sale , and EcoFlow’s current 72-hour early Black Friday flash sale lineup, among others.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
EcoFlow TITAN Series Whole-Home Backup Ecosystem launches with up to $2,199 savings starting from $2,374
EcoFlow has officially launched its new TITAN Series Whole-Home Backup Ecosystem that is comprised of three models and various bundle options for each – plus, there’s even bonus extra savings. The three base options are the TITAN Classic at $2,374.05 shipped , after using the code EFTITANAFF at checkout, while the TITAN 5000 is down at $3,039.05 shipped (using the same code), and the TITAN 5000 Plus is down at $3,514.05 shipped (also using the code). These new models will go for $3,299, $4,099, and $4,999 after these launch deals end, with the initial discounts dropping things to $2,499, $4,099, and $4,999 before the bonus extra savings code cuts more from the tags. All-in-all, you’re getting up to $1,485 total savings off these three units and up to $2,199 savings with its bundle options available on each landing page (when using the above code). Likewise, folks who jumped on the $50 pre-order deal before today can log in to claim their extra savings there, too.
You can get the rundown on what to expect from this new backup ecosystem in our original launch coverage here .

Lectric’s new XP4 750 limited-edition e-bikes launch with up to $840 of FREE gear, cash in from $1,399
While we haven’t gotten the full Black Friday sale lineup yet, Lectric has launched new Limited-Edition XP4 Long-Range Folding Utility e-bike with up to $840 in FREE gear at $1,399 shipped , which includes new colorways and some notable accessories like a 5A charger for 3.5-hour charging. These new variations of the popular ride would normally run you $2,130 (for the $731 pannier bag-focused bundle) or $2,239 (for the two $840 cargo-focused bundles) at full price. The shared gear in all three bundles gives you a LevelUp cargo rack, a comfort seat, a suspension seat post, a phone mount, a bike lock, an Elite headlight, and the 5A fast charger. The differences here are either the 2x 24L waterproof pannier bags (with a Matte Black e-bike colorway) in one bundle , the steel-encased front and rear cargo baskets with a fishing rod holder (with a Matte Forest e-bike colorway) in the second bundle , or the same cargo baskets with a small roll top basket bag (with a Matte Thistle e-bike colorway) in the third bundle .
Lectric’s three new Limited-Edition XP4 750 e-bike deals:
XP4 750 Matte Black e-bike with FREE $731 bundle: $1,399 (Reg. $2,130) comes with FREE LevelUp cargo rack, comfort seat, suspension seat post, phone mount, bike lock, Elite headlight, 5A fast charger, and 2x 24L pannier bags.
XP4 750 Step-Thru Matte Forest e-bike with $840 bundle: $1,399 (Reg. $2,239) comes with FREE LevelUp cargo rack, comfort seat, suspension seat post, phone mount, bike lock, Elite headlight, 5A fast charger, steel-encased front and rear cargo baskets, and fishing rod holder.
XP4 750 Step-Thru Matte Thistle e-bike with $840 bundle: $1,399 (Reg. $2,239) comes with FREE LevelUp cargo rack, comfort seat, suspension seat post, phone mount, bike lock, Elite headlight, 5A fast charger, steel-encased front and rear cargo baskets, and small roll top bag.
And other e-bike model deals here…
Black Friday delivers Monarc’s first price cuts on Marker all-terrain + Tracer commuter e-bikes from $1,299
Alongside the new XP4 750 Limited-Edition e-bikes launching , Lectric’s sub-brand, Monarc Bikes, is offering its Black Friday deals early , which include the very first price cuts with the new battery configurations. Since October riders have gained new options for these two e-bikes, with the Tracer Urban Commuter Smart e-bike (no battery) at $1,299 shipped , or you can get it with one battery at $1,549 shipped and 2x batteries at $1,799 shipped . On the other end is the Marker All-Terrain Smart e-bike (no battery) starts at $1,399 shipped , or get it with one battery at $1,649 shipped and 2x batteries at $1,899 shipped . As I mentioned, these are the very first cash savings offered on these e-bikes since launching earlier in the year, with it only being the second sale since the brand has begun offering the three battery options.
You can learn about both these e-bikes in our original coverage of these Black Friday deals here .
Govee’s self-adjusting Outdoor Matter Lamp Post with security notifications at new $140 low ($110 off)
Through the official Govee Amazon storefront, you can get the best price to date on the Outdoor Lamp Post with Matter for $139.99 shipped , beating out the direct website by $20 . Down from $250, this model has seen discounts drop the cost to $150 since late June, which was the previous low before today’s deal. Now, you’re getting a $110 markdown here that dips further for a new all-time low price. You can find more deals on various other lighting devices in the official Amazon storefront here .
Worx’s 13A 2,200 PSI electric pressure washer is a budget-friendly way to clear grime at $161 (Reg. $290)
Expand the Worx Aerocart’s 8-in-1 functionality with this Firewood Carrier attachment down at a $30 2026 low
